name: Job Board
description: Job listings with a public application form (anti-spam honeypot + timing + rate cap), an applications inbox with statuses and CSV export, and a Verso block with search, type and remote filters. WordPress parity: WP Job Manager.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Run the plugin's own compiled interface in the browser: its admin page and its Verso block (in the editor and on public pages). Without it the host does not serve these bundles and that interface does not load.
Read job listings and received applications from the plugin's own tables.
Create the jobs/applications tables, store applications and count listing views.
Read the board configuration (currency symbol, notification email, salary visibility).
Save the board configuration from the admin page.
Public endpoints for the job list/detail and the application form, plus admin CRUD endpoints.
Add the 'Empleos' entry to the admin sidebar.
Notify the configured email (or the job's apply email) when a new application arrives.
